resources.string: An app-private folder and one authorized SAF folder (authorize it in Files first). New files and one-sided changes copy both ways; conflicting edits, deletions and type changes pause. Automatic runs are at least 15 minutes apart and may be delayed.
Relative folder path (empty for the granted SAF root)

Incomplete; paused. Check files and transfer recovery in Files before retrying.
Compare both folders in Files and keep the intended content. Make both sides equal or restore missing items before retrying. Deletions are not propagated automatically.
